harper: :rotating_light: ap-south1 OOB mesh is flapping during the nightly firmware batch. Seen ~30 BMC reconnects in the last 10m, multiple GPU racks marked provisioning-failed and some nodes show secureboot=0 even though we pushed secureboot-enabled image.
ops-bot: deploy-batch-7 started to ap-south1 at 2026-03-18T01:02:10Z (batch id: b7-ap-south1)
sre-bot: Alert: oob-network-flap detected on 10 hosts (severity: high)
lucas: looking at serial logs now — after the BMC reboots, BIOS reports "EFI variable write failure: -14" and then toggles SecureBoot to disabled. NV-RAM checksum errors appear immediately after warm reboots.
mina: wow. do we have an example log? can you paste the snippet?
harper: paste: ```
Mar 18 01:05:12 host-az3-gpu12 biosd: nvram: write error (rc=-14)
Mar 18 01:05:12 host-az3-gpu12 biosd: secureboot: state 1 -> 0 (bios-hook)
Mar 18 01:05:13 host-az3-gpu12 bmc: ipmi: session drop
Mar 18 01:05:17 host-az3-gpu12 kernel: efivarfs: write failed for var SecureBoot (error=-14)
```
lucas: those -14 errors look like EFAULT from the kernel when efivarfs can't write due to corrupted NVRAM region. Could be the new BIOS image's NV area layout change.
mina: suggested immediate mitigation: stop remaining batches in ap-south1, mark affected racks as "do-not-provision", and start rolling back BIOS on hitlist nodes to stable-20260212. Runbook snippet: ```
# check BMC and efivar
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P **** mc info
ssh -J jump@oob-jump $HOST sudo cat /sys/firmware/efi/vars/SecureBoot-*/data || true
# graceful warm reboot
ssh $HOST sudo systemctl isolate maintenance.target || sudo reboot
```
ops-runbook: runbook steps (short): 1) pause rollout (ops-bot), 2) tag affected nodes in inventory, 3) schedule BIOS rollback to stable image w/ cold power-cycle where possible, 4) verify SecureBoot and efivars, 5) repopulate. Link: runbook://oob-bios-rollback (internal).
harper: pausing batch b7 now. ops-bot: paused.
ops-bot: deploy-batch-7 paused by harper at 2026-03-18T01:10:02Z
lucas: note — cold power-cycle seems to preserve NVRAM better on these SKUs. Warm reboot tends to leave partial writes. Recommend cold power-cycle followed by BIOS flash via serial.
mina: capacity impact: ~120 GPUs in ap-south1 offline -> suggest divert non-latency jobs to eu-west and us-central. rough cost delta estimate: +$6k/day if we shift heavy GPU workloads to on-demand in other regions.
harper: tagging SRE on-call to handle capacity shifts. @lucas and @mina can you take the first 6 hosts for rollback?
lucas: taking hosts az3-gpu12..az3-gpu17. will start serial flash in 10m.
mina: i'll coordinate the workload migration and update cost estimates in the ticket.
harper: will open INC-2159 and capture timeline. we should also capture firmware binary checksum differences and push a regression test for efivar writes.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2159 created (impact: 120 GPUs, region: ap-south1)
harper: thanks team — keep updates short in this thread. we'll run a postmortem after containment. :thumbsup:
